In a statement on Wednesday November 18, Dr Obele said growing tensions between Iran and the United States, alongside increasing security concerns around the Strait of Hormuz, should stir action towards the refinery resuscitation.
He warned of possibility of further military escalation in the Middle East which presents significant risks to global crude oil supply, petroleum product availability, shipping costs and international energy prices. Obele, stressed that any prolonged disruption around the Strait of Hormuz could have serious consequences for oil-importing countries, particularly those with limited domestic refining capacity.
